# KynexEdu

> KynexEdu is Pakistan's most complete cloud-based school management system and ERP, built by Kynex Solutions. It runs an entire school in one platform — online admissions and proctored entry tests, fees and online payments, attendance and biometric, exams and results, HR and payroll, library, transport, hostel, inventory, a parent portal, and WhatsApp/SMS notifications.

## About

- **Product:** KynexEdu — school management system / school ERP (SaaS, multi-tenant, cloud-based).
- **Made by:** Kynex Solutions (https://kynexsolutions.com).
- **Market:** Pakistan-first; supports PKR, JazzCash & EasyPaisa, WhatsApp, Urdu/English, and biometric (ZKTeco).
- **Built for:** single schools, multi-campus institutes, multi-institute owners, private & government schools, and madaris.
- **Apps:** Web, iOS and Android.

## Key features

- Online admissions: branded apply portal, application status tracking, parent self-registration, and AI-assisted shortlisting.
- Proctored online entry tests: live waiting room and anti-cheat (tab-switch / focus-loss) detection.
- Fees & finance: flexible fee structures, installments, online payments (JazzCash, EasyPaisa), refunds and reports.
- Attendance: daily student & staff attendance, biometric (ZKTeco ADMS), late detection, reports.
- Exams & results: scheduling, marks entry, weighted grading, report cards, public result search.
- HR & payroll, library, transport, hostel, inventory, cafeteria, visitor management, health records, behavior & counseling.
- Communication: WhatsApp, SMS and in-app notifications, plus a WhatsApp bot (FEE / RESULT / ATTENDANCE).
- Parent portal and mobile apps; role-based access for 19 role types.
- Public school website (CMS) per school, with custom domains and SSL.
- Enterprise security: PostgreSQL row-level security, FERPA-style PII audit trail.

## Pricing

- Free school registration, no credit card to start. Trial and paid subscription plans based on school size. Contact support@kynexsolutions.com for current pricing.
